empty: No widgets configured. Add some in Settings → Plugins or with the pencil button.
nothing_to_rotate: There are not enough open windows to rotate.
open_all: Open all (rotates them when they are already open)
save_failed: Could not save the widget list: {detail}

avoid_collisions.description: Move a window to the closest free spot when it would land on top of another one.
avoid_collisions.label: Avoid overlapping windows

card_preview.description: Thumbnail of each widget: a screenshot of the window when it is open, or a mock card.
card_preview.label: Card preview

close_on_launch.description: Close the panel as soon as a terminal is launched.
close_on_launch.label: Close panel after launch

columns.description: Number of widget cards per row in the panel.
columns.label: Columns

commands.description: Name = shell command. Each entry becomes a card in the panel. Entries added here are merged with the built-in ones, so nothing is lost.
commands.label: Commands

height.description: Height for widgets without a Layouts entry.
height.label: Fallback height

layouts.description: One entry per widget: anchor, size and optional offset. E.g.: cava = bottom-center, 1610x584; lavat = bottom-left, 802x582; unimatrix = right-center, 869x1424. Anchors: any combination of top, left, center, right and bottom. Use custom, WxH, x, y for absolute monitor coordinates.
layouts.label: Per-command layouts

margin.description: Pixel margin from the monitor edges for anchored layouts.
margin.label: Margin

output.description: Monitor connector where windows should open (e.g. DP-1). Empty = focused monitor.
output.label: Monitor

reuse_existing.description: If the command's window is already open, focus it and reapply its geometry instead of opening another one.
reuse_existing.label: Reuse open window

rotation.description: How the open windows swap places when the rotate button is pressed.
rotation.label: Rotation

rotation_sizes.description: Also swap the window sizes when they rotate.
rotation_sizes.label: Swap sizes too

width.description: Width for widgets without a Layouts entry.
width.label: Fallback width

x.description: Fallback horizontal position (monitor coordinates) for widgets without Layouts.
x.label: Fallback X position

y.description: Fallback vertical position (monitor coordinates) for widgets without Layouts.
y.label: Fallback Y position

subtitle: {terminal} · {margin} px margin · {output}
